title: L¹ translation estimate for C¹ functions: ∫_{B_R}|f(v + h) − f(v)| ≤ |h|·∫_{B_{R+|h|}}‖Df‖
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, f : ℝ^m → ℝ of class C¹, h ∈ ℝ^m and R ∈ ℝ. Then ∫⁻_{B_R(0)} |f(v + h) − f(v)| dv ≤ |h| · ∫⁻_{B_{R+|h|}(0)} ‖Df(w)‖ dw. Here ‖Df(w)‖ is the operator norm of the derivative, which equals |∇f(w)|, and both sides are [0, ∞]-valued integrals.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (f : Euclid m → ℝ) (h : Euclid m) (R : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 f → ∫⁻ v in ball (0 : Euclid m) R, ‖f (v + h) - f v‖ₑ ≤ ‖h‖ₑ * ∫⁻ w in ball (0 : Euclid m) (R + ‖h‖), ‖fderiv ℝ f w‖ₑ
